Binance Suffers $6.3 Billion Crypto Hack, FBI Blames North Korea

Cryptocurrency exchange Binance experienced a hack impacting $6.3 billion in digital assets, believed to be the largest crypto heist on record. The FBI attributed the attack to "TraderTraitor," a cyber unit sponsored by the North Korean state, which allegedly stole the funds in minutes. Binance has stated it will cover customer losses and has replaced 95% of the stolen assets. The FBI noted that members of TraderTraitor have been observed converting stolen assets into Ether and anticipates further attempts to launder the funds. TraderTraitor has also been blamed for a $1.5 billion theft from the Bybit platform.
